title: FDA warns Chinese providers of compounding APIs over record-request refusals
snippet: Neither Chongqing Qiancan Technology nor Tianjin Healthcare Medical Technology provided the records requested by the FDA, leading the agency to issue import alerts and warning letters.

title: PepGen shares almost double as DM1 oligonucleotide achieves ‘best in class’ splicing
snippet: Mean splicing correction for PepGen’s PGN-EDODM1 was 46.5% at week 13, compared to under 30% for competitors like Dyne Therapeutics, Novartis and Ionis Pharmaceuticals.

title: Capricor parts ways with 10% of staff as FDA decision on DMD cell therapy nears
snippet: Awaiting a decision on Nov. 22 for its embattled Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy deramiocel, Capricor has reduced its workforce by 10% and slowed programs not directly related to deramiocel, the biotech revealed in its third quarter earnings report.

title: Capricor ramps up manufacturing spend ahead of FDA decision for DMD therapy
snippet: Less than two weeks away from a highly anticipated FDA ruling on its cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, Capricor Therapeutics has reported increased investment in its San Diego plant to support commercial production.

title: 2026 IPO stock tracker: How newly public biotechs are performing
snippet: BioSpace is launching an IPO dashboard to help the industry keep tabs on U.S. biotechs that have taken the public plunge in 2026.

title: China has a clear shot to 2030 goals, though economic, cultural barriers remain
snippet: To grow into a biopharma juggernaut, China aims to become the leading source of innovative medicines on the global markets—a goal that experts say the country is on track to hit.

title: Without US action on China’s innovation blitz, biotech leaders see a Rust Belt future
snippet: Policy uncertainty is hampering the growth of U.S. biotech as China rises thanks to carefully planned investment in the industry, experts said during a BioSpace webinar.
